instruction: Combine all .txt files from your VSCode project workspace into a single LibreOffice Writer document named 'bold_concat.docx' on the Desktop, merging contents without separators and applying bold formatting to all text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter concatenates DOCX paragraphs with newlines ('\n'.join at docx.py:41) but instruction says 'without separators'. However, metric normalization (' '.join(content.split()) at docx.py:30) converts all whitespace to single spaces, which makes verification work but relies on normalization rather than correct extraction logic

Getter cannot distinguish original .txt file boundaries after they're written to DOCX - it only sees DOCX paragraphs. Consider clarifying if verification should check file merging process or just final DOCX content
Expected content appears to be continuous text without paragraph breaks, but DOCX may contain paragraph structure. The normalization masks this, but it's semantically fragile
